question: Atal Tunnel, the world's longest highway tunnel connects Manali with ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahaul-Spiti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Atal Tunnel:

 
 
• On October 3, 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the ‘Atal Tunnel’ World’s Longest Highway Tunnel in Manali, Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The 9.02 Kilometre Long Tunnel has been constructed by Border Roads Organisation (BRO) at a cost of INR 3, 300 crores.
 
• It connects Manali and Lahaul-Spiti Valley.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://media.easemytrip.com/media/Blog/India/637420727834092566/637420727834092566b1ISAP.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Tunnel is built in the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas at an altitude of 3000 Meters (10, 000 Feet) from the Mean Sea Level (MSL).
 
• Prior to the construction of the Tunnel, Lahaul-Spiti valley was cut off for 6 months due to heavy snowfall.
 
• It reduces the road distance between Manali and Leh by 46 kilometres and time by about 4 to 5 hours, and the distance between Manali and Keylong (Himachal) will be reduced by 3-4 hours.
 
• The South Portal (SP) of the Atal Tunnel has located a distance of 25 kilometres from Manali and the North Portal (NP) is located near the village of Telling, Sissu, in Lahaul Valley.
 
• The Tunnel can withstand a traffic density of 3, 000 cars a day and 1, 500 trucks a day at a maximum speed of 80 Kilometres Per Hour.
